sourceAnchors.message: If you run in Java5 or newer and have concurrent access, you should use the ConcurrentHashMap implementation
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact HashMap is method-local to parse, never shared or returned. Every parse call owns its independent map, and private snapshot constructor immediately Map.copyOf freezes contents; observedValues exposes only an unmodifiable derived List. There is no concurrent mutable access, so a concurrent map would not solve an applicable defect.

sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: The exact executor is acquired before try; every exit executes finally shutdownNow and bounded awaitTermination10s with failing nontermination assertion. Implicit ExecutorService.close would wait without a bound. No returned or ignored resource owner.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact site belongs to a whole pure value JUnit Test, not a managed J2EE web application. Eight owned workers run64 literal byte tasks, each Future joins within5s, and finally shutdownNow/await10s verifies resource termination; no runtime authority or native action. Interrupt-set/read/clear sites only verify that this pure parser preserves caller cancellation; finally clears the Test-owned flag, not a production worker interrupt.

sourceAnchors.reason: This exact Test cleanup must fail on an unclosed worker or interrupt. It cannot return PASS after uncertain termination. This is a test resource postcondition, not a production exception priority exemption.
